info.title: Lynxus Extension Boundary Protocol
info.description: Extension Plane HTTP operations between Lynxus core runtime/control-plane services and extension services.

get.summary: Fetch the service-level extension manifest envelope.
Optional extension service diagnostic health endpoint.

post.summary: Representative path for toolConnector.endpoints.invoke. Actual path is manifest-declared.

get.summary: List ACTIVE channel profiles this extension should subscribe to for outbound frame streams.

200.description: Bootstrap subscription snapshot filtered by registrationId and providerType.

get.summary: Open the extension-facing SSE stream for a channel profile's outbound frames.
get.description: The SSE id is a short-lived streamCursor for transient replay only. Last-Event-ID never replaces finalSequence. FINAL_DELIVERY frames carry finalSequence, and extensions ACK them after idempotent provider handling.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Short-lived streamCursor for transient SSE replay. It is not a durable final checkpoint.

parameters.name: X-Lynxus-Last-Acked-Final-Sequence
parameters.description: Diagnostic extension-local final checkpoint. The gateway checkpoint is authoritative.

200.description: SSE stream with event: channel-outbound-frame and data: ChannelOutboundFrame.

post.summary: ACK a successfully processed FINAL_DELIVERY frame.
post.description: ACK applies only to FINAL_DELIVERY. The request advances lastAckedFinalSequence only after the gateway verifies this frame was forwarded in order. Raw provider response and credential fields are forbidden.

200.description: ACK accepted or duplicate/old ACK treated as successful no-op.

409.description: ACK is not the pending queue head or the gateway cannot prove ordered forwarding.

422.description: ACK payload is semantically invalid for current checkpoint state.

post.summary: Representative path for channelProvider.endpoints.runJob. Actual path is manifest-declared.
Representative path for credentialLifecycleEndpointProfiles.*.createCredential. Actual path is manifest-declared.
Representative path for credentialLifecycleEndpointProfiles.*.rotateCredential. Actual path is manifest-declared.
Representative path for credentialLifecycleEndpointProfiles.*.revokeCredential. Actual path is manifest-declared.
Representative path for optional credentialLifecycleEndpointProfiles.*.validateCredential. Actual path is manifest-declared.
Core internal endpoint called by remote channel providers.
Core internal endpoint called by remote channel providers for message-class inbound turns.

200.description: Turn accepted, rejected, duplicated, or failed after synchronous session-runtime dispatch.

supportsFinalDelivery.description: Must be true for FRAME_STREAM channel providers.

requiresIdempotentFinalDelivery.description: Must be true so repeated FINAL_DELIVERY frameId values are not sent twice.

frameId.description: Stable idempotency key for the frame. Replays of the same business action must use the same frameId.

finalSequence.description: Durable global ordering checkpoint for FINAL_DELIVERY only. It is distinct from streamCursor and Last-Event-ID.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable compact idempotency key for provider delivery; frameId remains the ACK/checkpoint identity.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload. The JSON Schema assets define illegal kind/payload combinations.

finalSequence.description: lastAckedFinalSequence candidate for the profile consumer; unrelated to SSE streamCursor.

lastAckedFinalSequence.description: Gateway durable final checkpoint for extension self-check.
